title: Lavender linen water
subtitle: A spray for sheets, pillowcases, and ironing
excerpt: A light lavender spray of distilled water, vodka, and essential oil for misting clean sheets and pillowcases before sleep, or spraying onto laundry before ironing. Makes 250 ml.
sourceNotes: Traditional linen water use in European domestic practice documented in Mrs Beeton's Book of Household Management (1861, public domain, Project Gutenberg). Lavender essential oil first-trimester and pet-safety notes: European Medicines Agency HMPC monograph on Lavandula angustifolia (2012, available at ema.europa.eu). Alcohol as a preservative and dispersant in spray formulas: standard cosmetic formulation references.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Make a 250 ml bottle and keep it on the bedside table or by the iron.
recipe.shelfLifeNotes: Keeps six months in a sealed spray bottle in a cool, dark cupboard. The lavender scent fades after three months. Discard if the liquid turns cloudy.

glossaryTerms.definition: A dilute, lightly scented water sprayed onto clean linens before folding or ironing. Traditional linen waters used dried herb infusions; modern versions use essential oils dispersed in an alcohol-water base.

content.text: is a light fragrance spray for sheets, pillowcases, and towels. This is a simple version: distilled water, a small amount of vodka to carry and disperse the essential oil, and lavender oil. Spray onto clean linens before folding, or lightly mist a pillow before bed. It also works as a light pressing spray for cotton sheets before ironing.
Lavender essential oil is toxic to cats. Use unscented distilled water for pets that sleep on the bed.

items.prepNote: tap water can be used but distilled avoids mineral residue on the fabric
plain unflavoured vodka (any brand); the alcohol disperses the essential oil and acts as a preservative

content.text: Add the lavender essential oil drops to the vodka in the spray bottle. Swirl to blend. The alcohol dissolves the essential oil.
Add the distilled water. Fit the spray cap and shake gently.

Shake before each use. Spray lightly over clean, dry sheets from about 30 cm away before folding. Or mist a pillowcase on the top side only and allow to dry before use. For ironing, lightly mist the sheet and press immediately; the water creates steam as the iron passes over it.
Keeps six months in a sealed spray bottle in a cool, dark cupboard. The lavender scent is strongest in the first three months. Discard if the liquid turns cloudy.
